correctness.rationale: PASS: normalize symmetric two-boson states and require gamma_j>0 so ker W is exactly vanishing of every adjacent-pair coordinate. Decomposition by simultaneous translation shows simple energies in each non-alternating sector; only antipodal Fourier pairs have edge amplitude zero. In the p=n/2 sector for even n, cos(pi p/n)=0 makes H=0 on the entire sector and the edge detector has rank one, yielding P_D=Q_pi-|e_pi><e_pi|+sum_{k=1}^{m-1}|phi_k vee phi_{k+m}><...| and dimensions n-1 or n-2 depending on n mod4. Overlaps give exact localized capture table including antipodal parity and adjacent absorption. Dissipative contraction plus absence of undamped Jordan blocks yields limit 1-Tr(P_D rho), independent of strictly positive nonuniform rates; no finite-time claim. Independent normalized spectral calculations for n=3,4,5,6,8,10 with unequal rates recovered ranks 0,3,0,4,7,8 and all distances' capture probabilities. These are corroboration, not an all-n proof.
